overview.title: أسواق دون زحام إمبراطوري
overview.p1: تخدم أسواق تارودانت السكان أولاً: خضار وبضائع منزلية وتوابل وبعض الحرف. أصغر وأقل مسرحية من مراكش، وهذا جزء من الجاذبية.
overview.p2: اذهب صباحاً لأزقى الممرات. ساوم بخفة على الهدايا؛ أسعار اليومي غالباً ثابتة.

moods.title: Souks through the day
moods.subtitle: Energy peaks in the morning and eases after midday.

1.title: Full market bustle
1.desc: Best time for produce, spices and local shopping atmosphere.

2.title: Quieter aisles
2.desc: Some stalls rest; still fine for a short browse.

3.title: Town evening
3.desc: Cafés stay open even when market stalls close.

food.title: الأكل في المنطقة
food.p1: Simple food stalls and nearby cafés offer snacks and tagines. Hygiene varies — choose busy places.
food.p2: For a longer meal, hotel or centre restaurants are more reliable.
food.li2: Cafés on the edge of the market.
food.li3: Tagine restaurants a short walk away.
food.li5: Hotel dining after a long morning.

1.title: Orientation
1.desc: Ask your hotel for the main souk entrances from Assarag.

2.title: Bargaining
2.desc: Light bargaining on crafts; food and household goods are often fixed.

3.title: Bags
3.desc: Keep valuables close in crowded lanes.

q1.question: Like Marrakech souks?
q1.answer: Smaller and more local — fewer tourist circuits.

q2.question: What to buy?
q2.answer: Spices, simple crafts, argan-related products from the Souss region.

q3.question: Need a guide?
q3.answer: Not required for a short visit.

q4.question: Open every day?
q4.answer: Core market days are busiest; some sections slow on Friday or afternoons.

q5.question: Safe for solo travellers?
q5.answer: Yes in daytime with normal city awareness.

a2.title: مشي الأسوار
a2.desc: كيف تستمتع بالأسوار المغرة دون الحر.
